subject: Retention handoff: annotate churn flags for Q4 forecast
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Retention handoff: annotate churn flags for Q4 forecast

Team —

Heads-up: Finance asked for a cleaned-up forecast export by EOD Monday (11/22). I kicked off a focused sweep on accounts with renewals in Dec–Jan and tagged the ones I think need a conservative commit. Please do the following by EOD Friday (11/19):

- Open the attached Q4_renewal_risk_sheet.csv and add a one-line rationale for any account you mark as "churn-watch" or "conservative_commit".
- Update Stage -> Commit (ACCEPT / PROBABLE / CONSERVATIVE) and include the expected renewal date.
- If legal/procurement is engaged, add the contact email in the notes column; if not, leave blank.

Priority accounts (please triage first): StratusHealth, Meridian Labs, and AltaCloud — I put row numbers in the sheet. Jordan: can you own StratusHealth? Marcus: pls re-check AltaCloud's usage numbers with CS.

I attached a short playbook note (stratus_intent_note.docx) with suggested verbiage and next steps for touching base. Low friction here will save us a bunch of back-and-forth with Finance.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Dunn <kate@stratushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Retention handoff: annotate churn flags for Q4 forecast

Thanks Neha — quick update from my side and a question for Kate (cc'd).

- I updated StratusHealth row to CONSERVATIVE_COMMIT and added a short rationale (procurement stalling, net-new contract scope).
- I added procurement contact as procurement@stratushealth.com and flagged the need for an executed order before 2027-01-15 to avoid price delta.
- Planned outreach: I'll send a short email to Kate + procurement today to confirm timing and ask for a purchase order.

Kate, is the 1/15 date workable? If procurement needs an updated quote from us, I can get Contracts to push one — otherwise, we'll mark as probable.

Attachments: none in this note.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (628) 555-0199

From: Kate Dunn <kate@stratushealth.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@stratushealth.com>, Contracts Ops <contracts@stratushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Retention handoff: annotate churn flags for Q4 forecast

Hi Jordan / Neha —

Thanks for the note. Quick answers: 
- Procurement is on a month-long review that should finish by mid-December; 1/15 is our target to have approvals and PO signed.
- We do need an updated quote that reflects the new seat count and the usage-based clause you mentioned. Could you send that to procurement@stratushealth.com?
- I attached the signed intent (pdf) that the business team signed internally; it does not replace a PO.

If Redwood can hold current pricing until the PO date, we should be able to keep this as a probable renew. If there are material price changes, we'll need to re-evaluate.

Kate Dunn
Head of IT Operations | StratusHealth

Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: Retention handoff: annotate churn flags for Q4 forecast (final update)

Finance — attaching the consolidated export and final ask. Per responses this morning, here is the calibrated guidance for reporting in the 11/22 forecast: 

- StratusHealth (STRATUS-2026-REN-09): mark as CONSERVATIVE_COMMIT; procurement target 2027-01-15. Finance should record a conservative dollar amount equal to 60% of prior ARR for the Q4 commit. Rationale: procurement review in progress; asset intent confirmed (see attached stratus_signed_intent.pdf).
- Meridian Labs: updated to PROBABLE after CS confirmed usage.
- AltaCloud: remains ACCEPT — Marcus confirmed steady usage and legal already engaged.

Action items (owner / due):
- Contracts: draft updated quote and send to procurement@stratushealth.com (Jordan) / due 11/24.
- Finance: record conservative commit for StratusHealth in forecast export and tag with deal_id STRATUS-2026-REN-09 / due 11/22 (EOD).
- RevOps (Neha): publish final sheet to the shared drive and link the HubSpot company record.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (StratusHealth record)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AabcdefgqrsTUVW
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/ABC-STRATUS-REN-2026

I'll keep the account on a churn-watch cadence and ping again if timing shifts. Thanks all for quick responses.
